line_items.description: Handheld 395nm UV blacklight inspection lamps (pack of 4)
Heavy-duty vinyl branded tabletop prize display tray (80cm x 60cm)

reasoning: Commercial invoice for event materials plus hardware, evaluated per line under its own category (Ch. 10). The note names the event ('blacklight scavenger hunt booth challenge at CloudFest Berlin') but does not state that the budget owner pre-approved the purchase. The Ch. 10 event-materials card-do requires BOTH statements; with pre-approval missing, the event material lines are deducted: the wristbands (185.00, promotional giveaway) and the display tray (45.20, booth display material). Per the Ch. 2 calculation steps, a deducted line also loses the tax charged on it; the event lines' share of the VAT is 43.74 (35.15 on the wristbands, 8.59 on the tray). The UV inspection lamps are hardware peripherals with a unit price of 39.90, under the 100.00 EUR threshold, so the Ch. 10 peripherals card-do makes them reimbursable with an itemized invoice; only electronics above the peripheral threshold stay non-reimbursable when bought for an event, and these are below it. The lamps are reimbursed at 79.80 plus their VAT share of 15.16 (79.80 x 0.19). Total reimbursed: 79.80 + 15.16 = 94.96 of the claimed 368.90.
